# LinkAlign: Scalable Schema Linking for Real-World Large-Scale Multi-Database Text-to-SQL

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#linkalign-ambidb)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.51.pdf) · EMNLP 2025 proceedings, pp. 977–991

**Reading coverage:** All 15 pages: main sections 1–5; Appendices A–H, error study, pipeline/agent procedures, single-database adaptations, complete AmbiDB construction and filtering, efficiency and limitations. Figure 2–3 plots visually inspected.

## Research question

A SQL system given many databases may retrieve incomplete schemas, select irrelevant databases, or lose necessary tables and columns inside the correct database.

## Method

LinkAlign uses iterative query rewriting to improve retrieval, filters candidate databases, then extracts relevant schema items. Each stage has a cheaper single-prompt implementation and a multi-agent alternative. AmbiDB expands Spider with overlapping schemas and rewrites questions while retaining clues intended to identify one target database.

## Evaluation

Schema-linking experiments on Spider, BIRD and AmbiDB measure target-database location, exact schema recovery and recall. Single-database tests assess grounding; SQL generation is evaluated on Spider/BIRD and Spider 2.0-lite. Ablations remove retrieval rewriting and filtering, and a 50-example sample measures end-to-end runtime.

## What the results support

The agent implementation improves schema exact match across the reported datasets, while retrieval and precision/recall trade-offs vary. On AmbiDB, pipeline database-location accuracy exceeds the agent variant, and competing methods attain higher recall. The paper reports a historical 33.09% Spider 2.0-lite result with DeepSeek-R1.

## Limits and qualifications

This is automatic schema selection, not user-intent clarification or abstention. AmbiDB is synthetic and deliberately preserves disambiguating clues; its public release availability is a separate artifact question. Strongest performance claims do not hold for every metric, and headline SQL comparisons use differing backbones. Extra agent reasoning increases measured runtime.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

An adjacent benchmark for retrieval ambiguity in large schema pools, useful for separating failure to find the intended database from genuine missing information that requires asking the user.
